prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Houston, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1274; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is for the claim file. Can you please state your full name for the record?

A: Sure. Please use the placeholder, [CLAIMANT NAME].

Q: Thank you. Do you understand that this call is being recorded and that you should answer as completely and honestly as you can?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Tell me in your own words what happened at the intersection.

A: I was driving through the city and needed to turn left onto a side street. There was a gap in oncoming traffic, so I started my turn. Then a vehicle coming from the opposite direction struck the front driver's side of my car.

Q: Were you turning on a green light or a green arrow?

A: It was a green light, but I believe the signal had been green for a while. I was not in a left-turn lane, I was in the through lane and turned from there.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you started your turn?

A: I saw headlights, but they seemed far enough away. I thought I had time.

Q: How fast do you think you were going when you began the turn?

A: Probably around fifteen or twenty miles per hour. I was not rushing.

Q: Did you feel any injuries at the scene?

A: My lower back was sore right away, and by the next morning it was stiff and painful when I bent or lifted anything.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to my doctor and was told I have a back strain. I am still doing physical therapy.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get this resolved.

Q: Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the recorded statement.
